title: Share Trading Policy

tiers.name: All Personnel
tiers.description: All directors, officers, employees, contractors or secondees of Gentrack and any of its subsidiaries. Subject to the fundamental insider trading rule, blackout periods, and the requirement to obtain Commercial Manager consent before trading.

tiers.name: Directors and Chief Executive
tiers.description: Distinguished only for the consent approver: the Request for Consent form (for ordinary trading or a blackout-period exemption) must be signed by the Chair of the Board (or the chair of the Audit and Risk Management Committee if the Chair is absent or is the one proposing to trade), instead of the Commercial Manager.

tiers.name: Related persons
tiers.description: Spouse or partner, dependent children, and/or trusts of which you are a trustee or any company which you control. The policy applies to trading in Gentrack's listed securities in which the covered person is involved or instrumental, whether held in their own name or these related persons' names.

windows.start_anchor: close of the last trading day in August of each year
windows.end_anchor: the first trading day following Gentrack's announcement via NZX and ASX of the preliminary final statement or full year results

windows.start_anchor: close of the last trading day of February of each year
windows.end_anchor: the trading day following Gentrack's announcement via NZX and ASX of the half-yearly results

ad_hoc_blackout_authority: Gentrack may specify 'any other period' as a blackout period from time to time, and the Commercial Manager has discretion to reduce or extend (conditionally or unconditionally) the blackout periods; not stated to be confidential.

rules.detail: 'Trade' is defined narrowly as buying or selling listed securities or agreeing to do so; derivatives, options or other financial products over Gentrack shares are not named and are not swept in by this definition.
Hedging or economic-risk-limiting arrangements are not mentioned anywhere in the policy.
Monetisation structures (e.g. prepaid forwards) are not named and are not caught by the narrow buy/sell 'trade' definition.
Short selling is not named anywhere in the policy.
Securities lending is not named and is not caught by the 'trade' definition (buying or selling, or agreeing to do so).
CFDs are not named and, as derivatives rather than the listed shares themselves, fall outside the 'trade' definition.
Margin lending is not mentioned anywhere in the policy.
Granting security, a charge, lien or pledge over Gentrack shares is not mentioned and is not caught by the 'trade' definition.
Secured financing arrangements in respect of Gentrack shares are not mentioned anywhere in the policy.
Buying or selling within a six month period is discouraged rather than absolutely banned; it can proceed with exceptional circumstances discussed with, and approved by, the Commercial Manager.
rules.evidence: You should not engage in short term trading (the buying or selling of Gentrack shares within a six month period) unless there are exceptional circumstances discussed with and approved by Gentrack's Commercial Manager.

clearance.post_trade_deadline: promptly following completion of any trade
clearance.evidence: A consent is only valid for a period of ten trading days after notification. A consent is automatically deemed to be withdrawn if the person becomes aware of material information prior to trading.

clearance.approver: Chair of the Board (or, in the Chair's absence or where the Chair is the proposed trader, the chair of the Audit and Risk Management Committee)
clearance.post_trade_deadline: promptly following completion of any trade
clearance.evidence: In the case of proposed trading by a director or the chief executive, the Request for Consent form must be signed by the chair or, in his or her absence, or in the case of proposed trading by the chair, by the chair of the Audit and Risk Management Committee.

short_term.basis: buying or selling within the period
carve_outs: exceptional circumstances discussed with and approved by the Commercial Manager
short_term.evidence: You should not engage in short term trading (the buying or selling of Gentrack shares within a six month period) unless there are exceptional circumstances discussed with and approved by Gentrack's Commercial Manager.

exceptions.evidence: acquisitions and disposals of Gentrack shares by gift or inheritance
acquisitions of Gentrack shares through an issue of new listed securities, such as an issue of new shares under a rights issue, share purchase plan or a dividend reinvestment plan
trading of Gentrack shares where the trading results in no change to the beneficial interest in the Gentrack shares
nothing in this policy will apply to the trading of shares in respect of a takeover made under the Takeovers Code Approval Order 2000

exceptions.approver: Commercial Manager (Chair of the Board, or chair of the Audit and Risk Management Committee, for a director/chief executive), in his or her sole discretion
exceptions.evidence: severe financial hardship where the person has a pressing financial commitment that cannot be satisfied otherwise than by selling the Gentrack shares

exceptions.approver: Commercial Manager (Chair of the Board, or chair of the Audit and Risk Management Committee, for a director/chief executive), in his or her sole discretion
exceptions.evidence: compulsion by court order or court enforceable undertakings or other legal or regulatory requirements

exemption_authority: Gentrack's directors may approve updates, amendments to and exemptions from this policy generally, implemented by written notice (clause 12). Separately, the Commercial Manager (or the Chair/Audit and Risk Management Committee chair for a director or chief executive) may grant a blackout-period trading exemption in his or her sole discretion for exceptional circumstances, valid for two trading days from notification and automatically withdrawn if the person becomes aware of material information before trading.
jurisdiction_overlays: NZX Main Board Listing Rules and New Zealand insider trading law
Securities Markets (Disclosure of Relevant Interests by Directors and Officers) Regulations 2003 (NZ)

bespoke_clauses.topic: narrow trade definition excludes derivatives and financing
bespoke_clauses.clause: In this policy, "trade" includes buying or selling listed securities or agreeing to do so, whether as principal or agent.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Because 'trade' is confined to buying/selling the shares themselves, an OTC put, written call and a loan secured on the collared shares are not named and are not swept in by this definition, so the policy as drafted does not restrict entry into a funded collar; general insider trading law still applies regardless of the policy's silence.

bespoke_clauses.clause: you must, in writing: (a) notify the Commercial Manager of your intention to trade Gentrack shares and seek consent to do so ... A consent is only valid for a period of ten trading days after notification.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: If the collar's written call is physically settled by delivering shares to the bank, that delivery is a 'sale' and therefore a trade requiring prior notice, consent (valid only 10 trading days), confirmation of no material information, and avoidance of blackout periods; cash settlement would avoid this.

bespoke_clauses.topic: no safe period with material information
bespoke_clauses.clause: There are no "safe" periods for trading in Gentrack shares. You may never trade in Gentrack shares if you have material information -- even if you are not in a blackout period.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Even outside a blackout period and with consent obtained, any share delivery/settlement under the collar cannot proceed if the executive holds material information at that time.

bespoke_clauses.clause: Persons who leave Gentrack will remain subject to this policy, and will be deemed to remain subject to this policy for a period of six months after their date of departure.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: If the executive departs while the collar or loan is still outstanding, the policy's trading-related restrictions (though not the financing/derivative legs themselves, which are unaddressed) continue to apply to any share delivery for six months post-departure.

bespoke_clauses.clause: Gentrack may monitor the trading of directors, employees and advisers as part of the administration of this policy.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Gentrack may become aware of collar-related share deliveries or off-market transfers through its own trading surveillance even though the policy does not require pre-clearance for the derivative or loan legs themselves.

summary: This policy's 'trade' definition is narrow -- buying or selling Gentrack's listed shares, or agreeing to do so -- and never mentions derivatives, hedging, margin lending, secured financing or encumbrance, so a funded OTC collar (purchased put, written call and a loan secured on the collared vested shares) falls outside its express scope and is not restricted by its terms. The only point of contact is if the call is physically settled by delivering shares to the bank: that delivery is a 'trade' requiring prior written notice to and consent from the Commercial Manager (or the Board Chair for directors/the CEO), confirmation of no material information, execution within 10 trading days of consent, and avoidance of the two annual blackout periods (unless a two-trading-day exceptional-circumstances exemption is separately obtained). There is no absolute prohibition anywhere touching the derivative or financing legs, and no minimum shareholding requirement or forced-sale provision is addressed. Cash-settling the collar would avoid engaging the policy at all beyond the fundamental, ever-present insider trading prohibition. Post-employment, the policy (and thus any residual consent requirement for share delivery) continues to apply for six months after the executive leaves Gentrack.
